meta.title: Team category picker with categories that share a name

args.goal: from the buyer portal, open Teams > All Categories > Edit Team and verify that categories sharing a name are visibly distinguishable by distinct identifying information such as code or another unique attribute; stop on the category list showing the distinction

steps.note: Navigates to the Teams category picker and directly verifies the requested duplicate-name disambiguation.
Confirms the resulting category screen has no crash, server error, raw identifiers, or malformed values.
